name: openspec_intake
description: Resolve, pin, validate, and normalize a complete OpenSpec change from local, git, or public HTTPS archive sources.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git checkout that owns the run worktree.

specSource.description: OpenSpec source location: an absolute or file:// local path, a git URL, or a public HTTPS archive URL (.zip, .tar.gz, or .tgz).

changeId.description: OpenSpec change identifier; must be lowercase kebab-case.

specSourceType.description: Force the source type instead of inferring it from specSource.

specRef.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or SHA) to pin when specSource is a git source.

specPath.description: Repository-relative path hint used to locate the OpenSpec project root when it is not at the source root.

workspaceOwned.description: True when repoPath is an isolated worktree the workflow fully owns, allowing existing OpenSpec artifacts there to be overwritten during local-source materialization.

sourceResolution.description: Output of openspec_source_resolve; guides local-source materialization and writeback decisions.

materializeLocalSource.description: Whether the local OpenSpec source should be copied into repoPath.

sourceRepoPath.description: Git repository root containing the local specSource.

sourceOpenSpecRelativePath.description: Path of the openspec/ directory relative to sourceRepoPath.

sourceProjectRelativePath.description: Path of the OpenSpec project root relative to sourceRepoPath.

publishOnVerify.description: Whether the change must be published back to a writeback repository after verification.

specWritebackRepo.description: Repository to publish the archived change to when the source is not already part of repoPath; required for URL sources without an inferable GitHub origin.

specWritebackRef.description: Ref to check out in the writeback repository clone.

workflowId.description: Run identifier used to namespace the snapshot directory; defaults to the workflow instance id or task id.

valid.description: Always true on the success path; failures raise instead.

changeId.description: OpenSpec change identifier that was resolved.

contextPath.description: Path to the immutable, normalized context.md file written for coding_agent.

sourceProjectPath.description: Absolute path to the resolved OpenSpec project root.

sourceChangePath.description: Absolute path to the resolved OpenSpec change directory.

provenance.description: Source provenance recorded alongside the normalized context.

type.description: Source type: local, git, or url.

pinnedRef.description: Resolved git HEAD SHA when specSource is a git source; empty otherwise.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the resolved change directory contents.

validation.description: Raw JSON output of `openspec validate --strict` for the change.

status.description: Raw JSON output of `openspec status` for the change.

writebackRepoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository the archived change will be committed to.

writebackProjectPath.description: Absolute path to the OpenSpec project root inside the writeback repository.

sameRepo.description: True when the resolved OpenSpec project and repoPath share the same git identity.

materializedSourcePaths.description: Repository-relative OpenSpec paths copied into repoPath during local-source materialization.

forceAddPaths.description: Writeback-repo-relative paths that must be force-added to the archive commit even if gitignored.

publishOnVerify.description: Whether the change and its writeback repository must be published back after verification.
